title: Cozy Studio: K & Q Bed LUX Shower near Downtown
description:
Studio: Newly constructed totally private studio apartment in a great neighborhood, near Downtown Franklin, TN! Centrally located and only 25 mins from Downtown Nashville, a great spot to stay if you want to explore Franklin, Nashville, and more! The comfortable Modern design and decor will make you feel right at home while also having an upscale feel with beautiful bathroom and a rainfall shower head. Private keypad entrance and parking spot so you can come and go as you like!

The space
This studio suite is a part of the entire home, which is also available for reservation. Double locked by the doors to the rest of the home- this apt offers a wonderful place to rest while visiting Franklin. 

Please note-While occasionally there may be some noise from the other side of the unit, that is to be expected since it is attached to the rest of the home. No matter, the studio suite offers a comfortable and enjoyable stay.

Come and see!

Guest access
Private Cozy Studio Suite with big communal backyard with fire pit and grill.
